description: AETHER-G (Autonomous Edge Thermal & Hazard Emergency Responder powered by Gemma) is tackling Flame in Freefall with an edge-deployable fire safety copilot using local open-weights AI (Gemma). Operating completely offline for deep-space reliability, our tool analyzes microgravity combustion data (Saffire/BASS) to detect smoldering anomalies and advise crew in real time. Seeking ML/Python devs, UI/UX designers, and aerospace/physics thinkers!
